title: Algebraic formulas for first-passage times of Markov processes in the linear framework: generalising the work of Hill and Kac
summary: In a preceding paper, we used the graph-theoretic linear framework to show how transient properties of continuous-time Markov processes -- splitting probabilities and the moments of first-passage time (FPT) distributions -- could be expressed as rational algebraic functions of the transition rates, by using spanning forests of the underlying graph. This contrasts with the related rational formulas for steady-state (s.s.) probabilities, which use only spanning trees.
